This is a question of bifactor model specification in Mplus and doesn't pertain to MplusAutomation. There are examples of bifactor Mplus syntax such as: http://myweb.fsu.edu/yyang3/files/Mplus%20syntax.txt. I would start by reviewing these and then posting to the statmodel.com forums if it remains unclear.

Michael
